mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_type, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, (select a.given_name from nad_user_applicant_access acc join nad_applicant a on a.id = acc.applicant_id where acc.user_id = u.user_id and acc.access_role = 'OWNER' and acc.status = 'ACTIVE' order by acc.id limit 1) as owner_given_name, (select a.photo_media_id from nad_user_applicant_access acc join nad_applicant a on a.id = acc.applicant_id where acc.user_id = u.user_id and acc.access_role = 'OWNER' and acc.status = 'ACTIVE' order by acc.id limit 1) as owner_photo_media_id from sys_user u where u.user_id in #{id}

select a.photo_media_id from sys_user u join nad_user_applicant_access acc on acc.user_id = u.user_id and acc.access_role = 'OWNER' and acc.status = 'ACTIVE' join nad_applicant a on a.id = acc.applicant_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and (u.user_type is null or u.user_type <> '00') and a.photo_media_id is not null order by acc.id limit 1
